superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Povezivač
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: U 17:59 u petak, Sensor.Community je primljen pre 11 min, dok je Parking Servis primljen pre 21 min i još uvek ne daje vreme merenja. Prikaz za VMA pomerio se sa 237 na 556 kroz prijeme, ali osveženi naslovi Danasa, Studija B, Bete, RTS-a i Euronewsa ne pružaju potvrđenu vezu vremena ili mesta događaja sa tim pomeranjem. [F1][F3][F4][F5][F7][F8][F9][F14][F16]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: At 17:59 on Friday, Sensor.Community was received 11 min ago, while Parking Servis was received 21 min ago and still supplies no measurement time [F1][F3][F4]. The VMA display moved from 237 to 556 across receptions, but the refreshed Danas, Studio B, Beta, RTS, and Euronews headlines provide no verified event-time or event-location connection to that movement [F5][F7][F8][F9][F14][F16].
hypotheses_sr: Pomeranje za VMA možda odražava petak uveče i smenu parkiranja, a ne neki događaj predstavljen u osveženim naslovima [F1][F5][F7][F8][F9][F14][F16].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći prijem Parking Servisa zadržati ili preokrenuti pomeranje za VMA uprkos tome što nema vremena merenja [F4][F5]?
